main_text.l: Ei confidit ex animo maritus, nec ciba-
riorum est indigus. Ipsa de eo bene, non
male meretur per omnem vitam suam.
Surgitq; de nocte, & familiae suae cibum,
nuum quaestu pangit vineam, sua late-
ra fortiter succingit, suaq; brachia con-
firmat. Sentit quam bonum sit suum ne-
bet ac porrigit. Non metuit suam familiam
a nive, quippe cum sit omnis ejus familia
vestita cocco. Stragulam vestem sibi fa-
bet. Conspicuus est in curiis maritus ejus,
dum sedet in civium senatu. Lintea
stita futurum tempus eludit. Os suum

page.notes: Small "⌣"-shaped marks stand before "Admovet" and before "Manus"; they look like printed paragraph or pointing marks and are not text, so they are left out. "Praeclare" may carry a grave accent on the final e; I have read it as printed without the accent. The initial "N" of "Non" is a decorated letter and is read as N. The word "cocco" is printed with a double c and read as printed. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
